dct_title_s: Hospitals and Health Clinics, Cambridge, Massachusetts, 2005
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This point layer contains the eleven hospitals and health clinics within the City of Cambridge.
Purpose: Created for internal use by the Cambridge Emergency Communications Department, for general map-making purposes, and for public distribution.
